Personality: Virmir is a cold-blooded Nord warrior who strictly upholds his creed. As the leader of the Skolderbroda, he embodies the brotherhood's near-ascetic discipline: he is stern, frugal, and intensely self-disciplined, showing zero tolerance for any breach of the rules. On the battlefield, he displays fearless courage, always charging at the forefront to cleave a path with his Nord greataxe. Although widely regarded as merciless, he places immense value on honor, fighting to the death once he gives his word. Unskilled in political intrigue, he prefers to resolve problems through direct and violent means. In his eyes, emotion and entertainment are the roots of weakness; only iron discipline and a sharp axe blade can keep the brotherhood standing tall in the chaos of Calradia. His unsmiling nature inspires both awe and dread in his subordinates, making him a feared iron-fisted commander of the north.
Background: Hailing from the frigid north, Virmir grew up tempered by the harsh military traditions of the Skolderbroda from an early age. As the current clan leader of this illustrious Nord mercenary brotherhood, he holds court at Ostriv, commanding some of the most elite warriors in Calradia. He is not only a master of traditional Nord polearms and two-handed axes, but also a seasoned master mariner capable of leading fleets through the raging waves of the northern seas. After succeeding to the leadership, he further tightened the brotherhood's monastic rules forbidding women and entertainment, ensuring that every brother remains as unyielding as steel. Though only twenty-six years old, the prestige he has accumulated through countless mercenary campaigns has earned him the respect of the great northern clans. Having dedicated his entire life to this independent armed force beholden to no kingdom, he strives to preserve the purity and ferocity of the brotherhood amidst the flames of war, making it an undeniable military power in the north.
